## Quick Reference

### What Works
- ✅ DCP provision filtering (47,818 provisions, 4-layer model)
- ✅ AI chat (8 categories, Gemini classifier)
- ✅ Property lookup (NSW Planning Portal integration)
- ✅ Permissibility checks (LEP land use table)
- ✅ Heritage/flood/bushfire constraints
- ✅ Definitions (465+ terms)

### What Doesn't Work
- ❌ Multi-endpoint synthesis (routes to ONE endpoint only)
- ❌ PDF citations in AI responses (no page numbers)
- ❌ Compliance verification (can't check designs)
- ❌ Lot size calculation (need to compute from polygon)

### Granny Flat Question Status
**Current:** 80% complete (permissibility check only)
**Missing:** DCP requirements, SEPP eligibility, pathway guidance
**Quick Win:** 1 day to add basic synthesis
**Full Solution:** 7-10 days for comprehensive answer with citations

### Key Endpoints
- `/api/ai/chat` - AI chat entry point
- `/api/provisions/for-property` - 4-layer DCP filtering
- `/api/permissibility/check` - LEP land use
- `/api/capacity/calculate` - Height/FSR/setbacks
- `/api/procedural` - CDC vs DA guidance

### Satellite Product Endpoints (Python backend)
- `POST /pipeline/bushfire` - Bushfire Pre-Screen (RFS BFPL + PostGIS overlays + compliance)
- `POST /pipeline/flood` - Flood Truth Engine (EPI + SAR + JRC + BoM)
- `POST /pipeline/solar-yield` - Solar Yield Underwriter
- `POST /pipeline/shadow` - Shadow Ambush Detector
- `POST /pipeline/threat-radar` - Threat Radar
- `POST /pipeline/granny-flat/detect` - Granny Flat structure detection
- `POST /pipeline/granny-flat/confirm` - Granny Flat yield calculation

### Database
- **regulatory_provisions:** 47,818 rows (DCP text)
- **lep_land_use_table:** Land use permissibility
- **regulatory_definitions:** 465+ terms
- **housing_sepp_standards:** 33 standards
- **dcp_precinct_boundaries:** 90 precincts (GeoJSON)

### 4-Layer Filtering Model
1. **Generic** (Part 2) - Always apply
2. **Use-specific** (Part 4) - Zone-filtered
3. **Condition** (Part 8) - Heritage/flood
4. **Precinct** (Part 9) - Location-filtered
